review_description: I have dealt with the company twice (old house, new house) and they have been fantastic.The quotes provided are detailed and relatively easy to understand (for someone non electrical).The most recent installation was a Deye for battery and inverter and Trina for the panels.The price was $15800 ( not including VIC rebates) which came down a long way with the rebates.The battery is 30 kWh so we take very little from the grid.The installation was done in two stages. First the panel supports were placed and then on the second day the panels themselves, the batteries and inverter. It worked by the end of the day. Those involved were great, sensitive to our needs, answered our questions, very efficient and tidy. The electrical engineer who came to check the system was very pleased and there were no rectifications required.I have recommended the company to my colleagues at work and my relatives.

Overall the sales approach, the installation and follow up has been excellent.Installers and inspection and some remedial corrective work after inspection has been done as stated and in a friendly, positive manner, and they have all been punctual!

The sales quoting process was helpful and informative.  The installers were polite, and the company  helped organize the grid connection.  The connection took more than twice as long as quoted but that was probably not under their control

Everything was very straightforward. The sales staff were professional and helpful and very polite.The installation went exceptionally well, the team were punctual and thoughtful, and left absolutely no mess. It was done in a very timely manner, and very neat and tidy.The grid connection handled by the limitless staff, and I was very grateful for that as well as the clear advice on how to access the government grants.
Every thing went very smooth office people were always happy to work with me and solve the problem
Came in person to quote,Prompt in all dealings.Swiftly and competently fitted.All good!

Very quick to follow up and transparent quoting process.Polite and punctual interaction with installation crew.. Installation was quick and willing to work with me on inverter location. Electrician's craftsmanship left a bit to be desired but overall, very good work.

The sales/quote process was very easy and informative. The quote was done straight away. Because of Covid the installation was delayed so only just had installation done on Wednesday 1st September but everything went smoothly. The installers were brilliant punctual exceptionally polite and informed me on everything they were doing. They cleaned up every single scrap of rubbish and put everything back in its spot. Grid install was inspected today so we are now up and running. Couldn’t be happier with limitless energy group. Would recommend them to everyone.
Process was easy & quick, installation went smoothly.  Everything was organised for us, really easy to work with.

Our experience with Limitless Energy was great.  From the first phone call right through to working with the energy company and Govt post installation.Very pleased with the workmanship and office support.Joe from sales was very accommodating even when requesting the 3rd quote variant.  He responded very promptly.

I dealt with Joe from Limitless Energy group and had a great experience as we were in lockdown at the time he let me know that as soon as they could get out to us they would and they were very accomodating with times and came out on a Saturday afternoon. I was continuously asking questions and tweaking the layout of the system and they were very happy to make all the changes and ended up sending me about 3 different quotes for varying sizes of systems. The installers were very professional and quick they had the whole job done in half a day, they helped me set up the app on my phone and showed me how it all worked. We are currently awaiting the inspection but once complete we should be all good to go. Overall very happy with the whole process.
Limitless Energy provided confidence in the investment of solar and made it easy to move ahead with the knowledge I needed to know I was maki G the right decision.

Installer was quick to come out and provide a quote. Staff member who provided the quote was very friendly, professional and informative. Quoted price for the system was very competitive. Phone calls and emails were answered promptly.Installation was booked one week following our acceptance of their quote. Installers arrived on time and was complete within the allocated time. The entire process was carried out without any delays.Following the installation, we had some problems with the inverter data logger not logging the power generated throughout the day. Installer could not find a fault or rectify the problem. After a few minutes of reading online forums, I was able to rectify the problem myself.

I got all 3 suppliers to quote on same panels and inverter having decided this based on independent product reviews. Selected supplier based on price and initial preselection service Eg  response to questions, timeliness, home visit, meter board inspection.  On installation the staff we excellent, polite, hard working, rubbish removed and a next day follow up to ensure all ok. Assisted with registration post implementation.

Quote process varied, one company said my roof was not suitable and did not provide a quote, another said complex but doable and gave me a quote after the sales guy discuss with the company's lead electrician (this is the company we went with), another gave me a quote without any hassle, but I did not like the offer due to panel configuration and, limited number of panels.

I am very pleased to have Limitless Energy Group install my solar system 2 weeks ago. I am very happy that I got them from Solarquotes. Thanks Solarquotes. Right form the quotation up to post installation they showed that I made the right choice getting them as the most professional company to deal with. Prasada was very professional to discuss the installation process "in person"  which you would know whom you are dealing with rather than exchange of emails. Simone was very polite giving all the details for the job and the documents we need. Damian and Jake did the installation very quick and everything was in proper place. After the installation I have asked Prasada a lot of questions under the sun which I got the expected reply. Furthermore, I have proven that they don't sub-contract the job and they offer the longest workmanship warranty in the industry. Thank you guys. Keep up the good job. I will recommend you to my friends.

Thanks Prasada, Damien and the team at Limitless Energy for a truly professional install of my solar PV System. Great support all around and attention to detail. I would highly recommend them to my family and friends. Thanks guys
